newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada wholesale trade rises 1.7 pct in October.
newsitem.headline: Canada wholesale trade rises 1.7 pct in October.

text.p: Canada's wholesale trade rose 1.7 percent seasonally adjusted in October to C$21.94 billion, Statistics Canada said on Friday.
Sales, adj C$21.94 bln +1.7 pct +9.7 pct
Inventories, adj C$31.61 bln +0.1 pct -0.2 pct
Note - dollar figures are billions. Other figures are percentage changes.
A Reuter survey of economists had forecast a 0.3 percent month-on-month rise in October.
StatsCan also revised its figure for September sales to C$21.57 billion from C$21.52 billion.
The agency said the increase in wholesale sales in October was due to gain in nine of the 11 trade groups, which accounted for about 82 percent of total sales.

Sales of food products rose 4.3 percent in the month, and sales of computers, packaged software and electronic equipment rose 3.9 percent. These two groups accounted for 66 percent of the total gain in sales in October.
The only groups with declining sales were farm machinery, equipment and supplies and "other products."
